entities.summary: Sir William Tite was an English architect who twice served as President of the Royal Institute of British Architects. He was particularly associated with various London buildings, with railway stations and cemetery projects. He was the Member of Parliament (MP) for Bath from 1855 until his death. William Tite was a architects & engineers from City of London (1798, City of London–1873-04-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
